q: What do we know about ds-rdm-holdout-2025q1 in the reactivation-dormant project?
a: It is the randomised holdout from the Feb 2025 wave: 11,260 dormant accounts sent 2025-02-24 with a 10% control, outcomes through 2025-04-25, and it is the test set for the rdm uplift models.

q: What came of the SMS-versus-email test exp-302 in the reactivation-dormant project?
a: Raw wave-2 response was SMS 4.6% against email 3.1%; the randomised holdout then gave SMS 3.4pp against email 1.2pp uplift (fnd-rdm-sms-uplift), which fell to 2.1pp against 1.4pp after the consent fix (fnd-rdm-sms-uplift-v2).

q: What does rdm-uplift-v2 in the reactivation-dormant project use?
a: An X-learner on feat-rdm-last-activity-v2, feat-rdm-prior-response, feat-rdm-balance-band and feat-rdm-app-installed, plus the consent-corrected channel flag from fnd-rdm-sms-uplift-v2.

q: What targeting model does the reactivation-dormant project use now?
a: rdm-uplift-v2, shipped for the March 2026 wave by dec-rdm-ship-uplift-v2; it replaces rdm-uplift-v1.

q: What uplift at the top 20% does rdm-uplift-v2 reach on rdm-oot-2025q1 in the reactivation-dormant project?
a: 3.6pp, with Qini 0.47, against 3.0pp for the T-learner with the same activity feature (exp-307).

q: Why does the reactivation-dormant project target sends by predicted uplift rather than response propensity?
a: Prior responders showed 9.8% raw response but only 0.2pp uplift, and propensity targeting gave 0.9pp at the top 20% against 2.8pp for the uplift model, so dec-rdm-target-by-uplift switched the basis.
